## §720 · THE REFERENCE STUDY — DWARF FORTRESS IS THE CLEAREST COUNTEREXAMPLE TO INCREMENTAL LAYOUT, AND THE REAL AXIS IS MUTATED ACCUMULATOR VERSUS REPLAYABLE DERIVATION (2026-08-26 ~22:10 CDT; SEAT: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated)

- **§720.1 THE COMMISSION.** The owner asked, in two messages, that we study **how Dwarf Fortress
  generates a world in sequence** and **how the SimCity lineage grows cities that look organic**.
  A six-lens study with adversarial verification on the load-bearing claims, sourced to Tarn Adams'
  own 2019 step-by-step narration, DF Talk, the DFHack structure files, the GPL'd Micropolis source,
  Maxis' 2013 "State of SimCity" post, Parish & Müller (SIGGRAPH 2001), Conzen's Alnwick study, and
  watabou's own source comments. **Every claim is labelled DEVELOPER / SOURCE_CODE /
  REVERSE_ENGINEERED / COMMUNITY_FOLKLORE, and the study says where the record is silent.**
- **§720.2 ⛔⛔ DF DOES NOT DO WHAT THE PROPOSAL ASSUMED, AND IT IS THE CLEAREST COUNTEREXAMPLE IN
  THE FIELD.** **During the entire history simulation a DF site has no streets, no plots, no houses
  and no walls.** A site is an abstract record — owning civ, bounding rectangle, population as
  (race, count) buckets, a list of *named* abstract buildings, land-use counts, and a dated change
  journal — with a **null `realization` pointer.** Physical layout is built later, in **one pass**,
  by a step Adams himself calls *"realization"*, and it does **not replay history year by year**: it
  generates a layout at the site's *current* level and then **replays a compact dated change log
  over the fresh result.** DEVELOPER-grade, 12/23/2013, shipped in 0.40.01. **A DF hamlet never
  becomes a town** — Adams named removing "static overall types" as *future* work in 2014. What
  changes over a thousand years is a population number, an abstract building list and a damage
  journal.
- **§720.3 ⭐⭐ THE SENTENCE THAT REFRAMES THE WHOLE QUESTION.** *"The real axis is not 'all at once'
  versus 'one piece at a time'. It is **mutated accumulator versus replayable derivation**."* DF
  defers realization for **scale** — hundreds of sites, one visited — a problem we do not have. But
  the *shape* it arrived at is exactly what an immutable-history product wants: **layout is a pure
  function of (site seed, accumulated state, dated change journal)**, not an accumulator mutated
  across a thousand years. ⭐ **A layout carried forward as mutable state is a second source of truth
  sitting beside the record**, and the moment the renderer changes, every past world either drifts
  from its record or becomes unregenerable. **A derived layout cannot drift, because there is nothing
  to drift.** ⇒ **§718.1's finding that our fold is a pure replay is not a limitation to be overcome.
  It is the property.**
- **§720.4 ⭐ WHERE THE OWNER'S INSTINCT IS EXACTLY RIGHT, AND DF AGREES.** DF's **world-construction
  layer** — roads, tunnels, bridges **and walls** — *is* incremental and *is* recorded: each carries
  an **explicit stored per-embark-tile route** and a dated `CREATED_WORLD_CONSTRUCTION` event.
  **That is the class the owner's wall proposal belongs to**, and it is not site layout. ⇒ **The
  proposal was right about the wall and wrong about the interior**, and the two halves have different
  homes. ⛔⛔ **AND THIS VALIDATES REG-E1's DEFERRED ITEM.** §719.9 recorded that the needle survived
  because **`raiseWrap` publishes its ring but nothing about the point set it hulled**, so no
  consumer can ask the discriminating question. **DF stores the route. Publishing `hullSources` on
  the wrap is the same fix**, E1 priced it as digest-neutral, and it is owner-gated only because it
  is a schema shape. ⚠ **DF gives no support either way on the SECOND, LARGER ring** — its wall rule
  is undocumented at every grade. **Cite history for successive circuits, never DF.**
- **§720.5 DF's TERRAIN PIPELINE, AND THE TWO PROPERTIES WORTH STEALING.** Six coarse fields
  (elevation, rainfall, temperature, drainage, volcanism, savagery) seeded at mesh intersections and
  filled fractally, elevation by midpoint displacement; altitude fix-up; vegetation and biome
  counts; smoothing; volcanoes; **erosion and rivers, where test rivers carve channels into the
  elevation field**; smoothing again; **then rainfall recomputed with rain-shadow and orographic
  effects, then temperature, then vegetation, all from the now-final elevation**; salinity; region
  naming; geology and caverns; final verification; wildlife; **then civilisations placed; then the
  years begin.** ⭐ **(i) IT IS NOT ONE-WAY** — rivers rewrite the field that produced them and the
  dependent fields are re-derived afterwards. **The early fractal rainfall is a draft, not an
  answer.** ⭐ **(ii) IT NEVER MATERIALISES FINE RESOLUTION** — one world tile is 16×16 embark tiles
  of 48×48 local tiles, and neither mid-level detail nor any building geometry is computed during
  worldgen. **That is *why* history never has to rewrite terrain: a town's effect on the ground is
  composited at read time, not written back.**
- **§720.6 THE REJECTION BOUNDARY IS HARD AND EARLY, AND OURS MUST BE HARDER.** All ~26 of DF's
  rejection strings are checks on the **map or on initial civilisation placement**; none derives from
  simulated history. Rejection is a **full discard-and-reroll with unbounded retries** and no partial
  retry or parameter relaxation. **Once the first simulated year ticks the world is kept no matter
  what** — civilisations wiped out, the playable race extinct, every megabeast dead: DF **truncates**
  and hands you the world. **DF routinely ships bad-but-valid worlds.** ⇒ For us the consequence is
  structural rather than stylistic: **a rejection after year one would be a re-roll of a past epoch,
  which THE PROMISE forbids outright.** So **every condition that could make a settlement unshippable
  must be evaluated before the first recorded year, and everything after must be survivable and
  narratable.** ⭐ **That forces a decision we should make deliberately rather than discover: which
  degenerate outcomes are shippable product** — a settlement that dies, a wall never finished, a
  market that never appears — **and which are guarded upstream at terrain and founding.** This
  ratifies §718.6 (no rejection loops) from an independent direction.
- **§720.7 SIMCITY — THE ORGANIC LOOK IS THREE THINGS, AND ALMOST NONE OF IT IS GEOMETRY.**
  Across the whole lineage the loop is identical in shape: **the player builds the network and paints
  intent, and a per-parcel rule repeatedly asks "should something develop here, and of what kind?"
  It never asks "lay out this block."** The look comes from **(a) the irregular network**,
  **(b) incremental stochastic per-parcel decisions that leave blocks unevenly and NON-SIMULTANEOUSLY
  filled**, and **(c) a mixed population of buildings at different ages, stages and wealth levels.**
  ⛔ **It comes almost not at all from procedural building geometry — every game in the family stamps
  pre-authored axis-aligned rectangles, and every one of them visibly breaks where the network stops
  being rectilinear.** Micropolis (the only SOURCE_CODE-grade member) grows per tile on
  `zscore = globalDemandValve + localEvaluation`, gated by a 1-in-8 sampler and a ~10 % threshold, so
  development is slow, stochastic and scattered; **land value is itself an emergent blurred distance
  field from the population centre of mass, so no gradient is authored anywhere.**
- **§720.8 ⭐⭐ THE CHEAPEST HIGH-PAYOFF ITEM IN THE STUDY.** SimCity 4 draws a lot's **growth stage
  from a population-dependent probability DISTRIBUTION rather than crossing a THRESHOLD, so several
  stages coexist at any population** — *"the single biggest reason an SC4 city reads as aged rather
  than stamped."* **A table and a draw.** ⭐ And it is **precisely the mechanism DF lacks**, which is
  why DF sites read as static. ⚠ Our entropy must be **sourced from recorded facts, never a fresh RNG
  at render time** — *"a building that exists because a coin came up heads at draw time cannot be
  explained by the chronicle."*
- **§720.9 THE CONVERGENCE — FOUR INDEPENDENT LINES, ONE PUBLISHED DISSENT.** Parish & Müller
  (SIGGRAPH 2001) establish the canonical pipeline: L-system grows highways and streets, areas
  between roads become blocks, blocks recursively divide into lots, one building per surviving
  allotment, **allotments too small or lacking street access DISCARDED before the building stage** —
  with irregularity deliberately loaded into the **network** layer and **the finest layer deliberately
  kept clean** (concave allotments forbidden; lots assumed convex and roughly rectangular). ⭐⭐ **The
  sharpest single piece of evidence in the whole study is watabou's own source comment: *"Trying to
  keep buildings rectangular even in chaotic wards"*, attached to the code that ZEROES the angular
  jitter on the last splits.** The chaos dial bends the alley cuts; **it never bends the final
  building rectangle.** Cities: Skylines makes the road literally generate the parcel grid.
  ⭐ **And real morphology agrees independently**: burgage plots are long narrow strips running back
  from a street or market frontage, **progressively subdivided as population pressure grew**, in
  markedly linear plans (Conzen, Alnwick, 1960). ⚠ **The dissent, stated rather than buried:**
  Lechner et al. (2003/2006) invert the order entirely — land-developer agents parcel first and
  connect by road afterwards. And **nobody has published a measured ranking of variation mechanisms
  by visual payoff.**
- **§720.10 ⛔ WHAT IS NOT TRANSFERABLE, AND THE LINE IS THE WHOLE DIFFERENCE.** **DF's site layout is
  a plausibility surface nobody can check against the record — and DF does not even check it against
  itself**: off-screen conflict resolves against abstract quantities (`abstract_building` exposes a
  defence percentage) while **the drawn wall is never consulted.** *"DF's 'generate a plausible
  current-state layout and paint damage over it' is the right ARCHITECTURE and the wrong CONTRACT."*
  **Take *derived*; do not take *lazy*** — DF's deferral is justified by scale we do not have.
  **DF's determinism is not a model**: same terrain / different history is a live undiagnosed
  condition across eleven years and three major version lines, and DF survives it only because the
  save is authoritative. **SimCity's randomness is unattributable by construction.** **C:S's zoning
  cells are a warning, not a model** — a rigid cell grid on road segments fails at exactly the
  geometry a medieval settlement has most of: curves, acute junctions, sloped ground.
  ⚠ **SimCity 2013 is the cautionary case on simulation granularity**: Maxis made agents the
  substrate, could not scale them, and in October 2013 publicly **reversed a seven-month-old
  commitment** on city sizes, naming *the simulation* rather than rendering as the bottleneck.
  **If our history loop is agent-shaped, that ceiling is real and someone has already paid for it.**
- **§720.11 ⛔ THE ONE PLACE WE MUST DESIGN RATHER THAN BORROW, NAMED BY THE STUDY ITSELF.**
  *"The sub-question closest to our actual problem — how SimCity 4 partitions an irregular painted
  region into rectangular lots, how it breaks ties, what it does with leftover land — is documented
  nowhere.  Only player-facing behaviour is described anywhere reachable."* ⇒ **Fitting rectangles
  into irregular medieval blocks is ours to invent**, and the nearest published help is Parish &
  Müller's *discard* rule (allotments too small or without street access are thrown away before the
  building stage) plus watabou's stop-rule band.
- **§720.12 WHAT I AM CHARTERING FROM THIS, AND WHAT I AM NOT.** ⭐ **CAR-AGE** — §720.8's stage
  distribution, sourced from recorded facts: **the smallest item in the study and the best payoff per
  unit effort**, and it pairs with CAR-FOUND's refusal record (§718.2), because *pressure* and *age*
  are the two axes that make a fabric read as lived-in. Queued behind the running lanes. **NOT
  chartered:** anything that would make our history agent-shaped (§720.10's cautionary case), any
  render-time RNG (§720.8), and the second-circuit rule, **which must be sourced to history and never
  to DF** (§720.4). ⚠ **And §720.6 hands the owner a question I am not answering for them: which
  degenerate outcomes are shippable product.** It has to be decided upstream of year one or it cannot
  be decided at all.

## §721 · CAR-FOUND — THE REFUSAL RECORD LANDS AND THE SUBURB STOPS PRECEDING ITS OWN GATE; INSTITUTIONS CANNOT BE DATED BECAUSE NO DATE EXISTS; AND TWO LANES CONVERGE ON ONE NUMBER (2026-08-26 ~23:40 CDT; SEAT: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated)

  **no new test file, so no ratchet spent.** All three preserve refs verified unmoved before sealing.

  **(i) THERE IS NO FOUNDING YEAR TO BUILD FROM.** Of 840 live institutions, **0 carry any temporal
  field**; `nativeTier` reaches **1 of 840**; **705 of 840 carry no temporal or tier signal at all.**
  The brief told the lane to seat an institution in the epoch history says founded it — **history
  does not say.** ⭐ **The lane minted no dates**, which is exactly the instruction and exactly the
  temptation. **(ii) IT WOULD NOT FIT ANYWAY.** Seating once costs **639 ms**; per-epoch costs
  **8,101 ms** — **12.7×** — plus 89.5 ms of `projectPage`, for **~8,600 ms against the signed
  2,500 ms budget, 3.4× over.** ⭐⭐ **AND THE LANE FOUND THE CHEAP VERSION OF WHAT I ACTUALLY
  WANTED:** if a founding year is ever minted, the answer is **not** per-epoch seating but **one pass
  weighted by per-face `appearanceEpoch` — already knowable for 710 of 710 seats at ZERO fold cost.**
  The ground already remembers when it appeared even though the institutions do not. **Any future car
  proposing to date an institution must mint the field upstream first.**
- **§721.3 ⭐⭐ THE REFUSAL RECORD IS LANDED — §718.2 IS DISCHARGED.** `demand[]` and `demandTotals`

- **§721.4 ⭐⭐ SATURATION CURED, AND THE DEFECT WAS SHARPER THAN THE ARITHMETIC PREDICTED.**
  The 1.0204 ratio is **exactly 1/0.98**, confirmed at the lane's own base. **An extramural emission
  fired in the wall's own raise year on 16 of 17 circuits at base; at the tip it is 0 of 17.**
  ⭐ And `emissionOrigin` types that first act `'gate'` — so what the corpus was actually drawing was
  **a gate-side faubourg minted in the same year as the wall: a suburb clinging to a gate that did
  not yet exist.** At the tip it forms the epoch after, which is what a suburb does. ⚠ The

  stated**; the nearest real subject is metropolis E13/y50 at **490 souls**. Near-right and
  mis-attributed; the lane reported rather than claimed it, correctly.
- **§721.5 ⛔⛔ MY ADDENDUM'S SECOND LEG IS REFUTED, AND IT POINTS AT SOMETHING MUCH LARGER — TWO
  LANES ON DIFFERENT SURFACES HAVE NOW CONVERGED ON ONE NUMBER.** I told the lane to pull the thread
  that *"hull vertices routinely exceed `frozenRadius`."* **Refuted: only 2 of 17 do.** The real
  defect is **AREA, not radius**. The drawn ring encloses a **median 0.2939 of the disc that capacity
  prices** — metropolis wrap 0 encloses **0.0149 of it.** ⇒ **`frozenRadius` is a SIZING TARGET, not
  an achieved extent, and capacity is therefore over-stated by ~3.4×.** ⭐⭐ **And 1/0.2939 ≈ 3.4 sits
  squarely inside REG-E1's independently measured saturation range of 1.81–3.97** (§719.5), which is
  what made me call the wall's empty interior dishonest. **One lane measured the wall's geometry and

  (J-FND-6)** — it moves what `saturation` means estate-wide, which is a shape change to a published
  quantity, not a repair. **It is the largest thing left on this surface.**
- **§721.6 ⭐ THE METHOD THAT SETTLED IT, AND IT IS CHEAP AND GENERAL.** The lane discriminated a
  legitimate exclusion factor from a unit error **without any geometry at all**: the residual was
  **exactly 1.020408 = 1/0.98 on every leaf**, and *a constant residual is a constant's fingerprint —
  a unit error would be leaf-varying and geometry-driven.* It then proved capacity's use of the field
  is the **round-trip of the producer's own map** (`populationForRadius` inverts `radiusAt`, which
  minted the field), identity on 8 of 10 probes. ⭐ **Round-trip identity of a producer's own map is
  the cheapest way to clear a denominator of suspicion**, and it is now the standing method for the

- **§723.4 THE ROOFS RESEARCH IS COMPLETE AND IS THE STRONGEST ARTEFACT THE PROGRAMME HAS PRODUCED.** Full headlines are in the handoff block and must not be re-derived. The three that change what we build: **Inkarnate's beauty is 30,000+ hand-drawn assets — an asset problem, not an algorithm problem — while its COHERENCE is algorithmic and does transfer**; **the owner's exact proposal is the documented failure case in the exact pipeline they named**, because Watabou's export omits what the illustrator needs and CityEngine's frontage selectors fall back **silently**; and **in true orthographic plan, pitch is invisible** — a 45° thatch and a 15° pantile roof over one footprint produce the identical line drawing, with pitch entering through exactly three channels (facet tone, shadow length, eave overhang).
- **§723.5 ⛔⛔ THE TRAP THAT WOULD HAVE BITTEN US IN A YEAR, RECORDED BEFORE IT COULD.** The straight skeleton of a long narrow rectangle puts the ridge on the **long axis regardless of history**, so every deep burgage plot would get a ridge running **into** the street instead of a gable facing it — backwards, and plausible enough that nobody notices. **Ridge direction is the frontage signal, and it is fully visible in true plan**, which is simultaneously the strongest argument for staying in plan and the thing a naive skeleton destroys. ⇒ **Derive the ridge from the frontage edge, never from polygon proportions**, and if the partition carries no frontage edge, **say so with the measurement rather than defaulting.** Same class as §710.6 and §719.2: an object anchored to one geometry while the drawing used another.
- **§723.6 THE FIFTEEN-FIELD HANDOFF IS THE REAL DELIVERABLE OF THE RESEARCH, AND IT SHOULD PROBABLY BE BUILT FIRST.** Footprint ring with fixed winding and stable indices · per-edge orientation enum · per-edge street reference · explicit primary frontage index · ridge axis · party-wall adjacency · closed-vocabulary building type · eave and ridge height · covering material with minimum pitch · full plot ring · ground slope · a stable per-building seed from a durable id · importance rank · block id · provenance token. ⭐ **The rule: anything the illustrator would otherwise guess must be recorded by the planner, and every absent value must be an explicit sentinel — never a defaultable zero. Silent fallback is how BOTH reference systems fail.** ⚠ **Retrofitting frontage is a PLANNER change, and planner changes reach back into recorded history** — which is why this precedes the visible work.
- **§723.7 ⭐ THE PRODUCT IDENTITY FINDING.** **No tool found, procedural or otherwise, generates market stalls or carts as real positioned objects.** MFCG places exactly one object in a market ward. And under our own constitution a stall is drawable only when the record holds a market day and a trader — so **our market is full on market day and empty otherwise, and market-place encroachment becomes a visible consequence of recorded history.** Nobody else can do this, because nobody else has the history.
- **§723.8 WHAT A SUCCESSOR DOES FIRST, IN ORDER.** **(1) Resume CAR-WEAVE** from `$SP/WEAVE-RESUME.md` — its TODO is live and the authoritative gate (expect 549 collected) is the one remaining step; then amend §721.8's declared shift with the moved rings and seal. **(2) Dispatch CAR-PROBE** (`$SP/briefs/PROBE-BRIEF.md`) — the cheapest experiment that settles the biggest uncertainty, namely whether individually-drawn roofs are affordable at all once **paint** is measured. **(3) Re-run the two stopped workflows** by `scriptPath` rather than reconstructing them. **(4) Charter the fifteen-field handoff.** ⛔ **Nothing on the owner's docket may be decided for them**, and it has grown to nine items — the framing trade, the enclosure operator, the ~3.4× capacity over-statement, the soul deltas, which degenerate outcomes are shippable, the projection call, the art route, the cutover flag, and the tuning signature.

- **§766.1 THE DIRECTIVE (owner, in-chat, verbatim intent):** *"if you ever see something that can be built better than what it currently is rather than me to maximally be safe with what it's currently built, always choose to do the former, even if it introduces risk and then deal with the fallout. This goes for architecture, code, experience, etc… I would rather we do our best to get on an engineering level the absolute best product now before launch rather than try to solve it after we launch."* CHAIR READING: **"the current form is load-bearing and green" is NO LONGER a valid reason to keep an inferior form** — pre-launch, the better construction is the default ruling everywhere (architecture, code, UX), with risk priced and absorbed INSIDE the arc. The discipline that survives is not conservatism but the fallout machinery itself: byte-identity goldens prove behavior-preserving rebuilds, SHIFT RECORDs price behavior-moving ones, the gate catches what targeted suites cannot, and a rebuild that reds gets fixed, not reverted to the inferior form. By-nature carve-outs and the map-module exception unchanged. This ratifies-and-hardens the standing fix-philosophy (bold architecture over patches) and risk-appetite rows into absolute pre-launch law.
- **§766.2 CONVERSIONS — recent "maximally safe" postures FLIP to chartered rebuilds:** **TE-NPCGEN-1** (the 1,690-line frozen relic decomposed and renamed to house standard — generateNPCGoal that returns a power level, the ~438-line mergeNPCLists, single-letter params, all cured; byte-identical goldens prove the refactor; the shrink-only freeze RETIRES on completion; the 23-site inlined toggle-key lookup gets its ONE shared reader in the same wave, and the reroll-path linkage drift is investigated and unified to the 3-tier policy — a declared shift if outputs move) · **strict-mode-in-production evaluation rides TE-GUARDS-1** (measure the runtime cost of the pipeline's strict contract in prod; if affordable, it ships ON — the contract's reach stops equaling the test matrix's reach) · **TE-KERNEL-1** (smalls: `generateSeed` hardened past the birthday-collision class — new-seed minting only, zero effect on existing worlds; the SIX `fnv1a32` copies consolidated onto the §761 zero-import leaf with identity-asserting proofs). - **§800.2 OWNER ADDENDUM (verbatim intent) — THE PARADIGM-AXIS TRAIT MODEL:** "there should be authored temperments and flaws... each temperment should have a corresponding vice flaw to show that everything is paradigm shift and a character can have mutliple tempemernets and multiple flaws. but they can't have the same temepermenet and flaw on the same axis. Rather I would like to also treat every temperement and every flaw as both on a larger paradigm chart but within their axis a spectrum too that effects their overall personality." + "by authored, i mean for each one to be already prewritten, the user simply gets to assign and choose and a correpsonding level." **Chair position (assessment in chat): ratify — this formalization SIMPLIFIES both prior designs.** The model: prewritten PARADIGM AXES (virtue pole ↔ vice pole); an NPC holds a signed, LEVELED position on each held axis (levels = banded words, never floats); the no-same-axis constraint falls out STRUCTURALLY (one position per axis cannot be both poles); multiple held axes = multiple temperaments and flaws at once. **It unifies: drift (§800) = movement along a held axis's spectrum around the authored anchor; "everything is paradigm shift" becomes MECHANICAL — sustained pull across the midpoint curdles a virtue into ITS OWN vice (compassionate → callous, never generic evil), and the ledger grammar already distinguishes band_crossing from REVERSAL, so the paradigm shift IS the reversal receipt.** Receipts: the vocabulary is ALREADY prewritten (NPC_PERSONALITY_TRAITS ~50/30/20 pools, npcData.js:74; users never write traits) and three signed-weight tables already put words on spectra (TRAIT_PLANE / TRAIT_ALIGNMENT / TRAIT_AGGRESSION) — under the axis model they become derived COLUMNS of ONE axis catalog, killing a three-parallel-hand-tables drift hazard (structural convergence). Pools pair up mostly (honest↔deceitful, merciful↔cruel, brave↔cowardly, generous↔greedy, humble↔arrogant, patient↔wrathful, diligent↔lazy, principled↔corrupt); orphans need mates (loyal lacks a treacherous pole in the pools); ⚠ LOCKSTEP LAW: npcBank NPC_TEMPERAMENTS mirrors the positive pool EXACTLY (npcData.js:111-113) — catalog work must move both. **Owner-taste rulings queued:** the neutral pool's place (own axes vs modifiers outside the chart) · whether a drift-acquired vice at depth opens CORRUPTION eligibility (chair recommends: authored flaws always; drifted vices only at the deepest level) · the held-axis cap (chair recommends ≤3) · levels per side (chair recommends 3: a touch / marked / defining). - **§800.3 OWNER ADDENDA (verbatim intent) + CHAIR RULINGS UNDER FULL DELEGATION** ("i leave all judgemetns to you. but think what would be best for hte users in experience yet also beleibable"): (a) "not just spies visiting settlements, also envoys too regarding what affects personalities"; (b) "gods should also be able to be assigned in this new paradigm shift axis thing we built and affect NPCs in hte same way as before just more coherent with the system we just built"; (c) "gods are immutable in where their personalities are... they do not shift." **Rulings (each vetoable):** **J1 — ENVOYS RIDE FREE, BY CONSTRUCTION:** the witness/milieu term reads the whereabouts mirror, and there is exactly ONE purposeful-travel substrate (J-SP-2, the errand spine) — so envoys, spies, and every future traveler take the same dwell-scaled milieu pull with zero extra machinery; envoys ADDITIONALLY take personal-plane lessons from the LIVE custody arc (intercepted/held/ransomed/pardoned — live today, unlike the spy capture writer which waits on ES-2b). Casting asymmetry is a believability gift: envoys are cast importance-DESCENDING (the realm's most visible people drift visibly), spies importance-INVERSE (nobodies drift quietly). **J2 — ONE SHARED PARADIGM CHART FOR GODS AND MORTALS; D2's separate mythic-flaw vocabulary is SUPERSEDED:** every D2 candidate flaw maps into the existing pools (jealous→envious, wrathful→wrathful, capricious→volatile, covetous→greedy, proud→arrogant), so a deity's character = leveled positions on the SAME axes (vice-pole positions ARE its flaws; FLAW_EFFECTS-style modulations attach to vice poles); the user learns ONE language of character across gods, priests, and shepherds, and news renders both in the same band words. D1's `authoredTemper` (warlike/peacelike/neutral stance dial) STANDS as a distinct dial — stance toward conflict is orthogonal to virtue axes (an honorable war god is believable and authorable). **J3 — SAME LEVEL WORDS, NO DIVINE TIER:** gods use the mortal level vocabulary (rank major/minor/cult ALREADY scales potency via DEITY_RANK_AUTHORITY — a divine intensity tier would double-encode strength); authoring defaults to defining, subtler gods legal. **J4 — DIVINE IMMUTABILITY IS STRUCTURAL:** deities have NO drift state and the drift writer takes NPCs only — a god's positions are frozen at authoring; only its FORTUNES (pantheon ledger) move. **J5 — AMBIENT SHAPES, COMMITMENT AWAKENS:** a deity's field pull moves only axes an NPC already HOLDS, toward the deity's pole, scaled by field weight × exposure × level; ACQUIRING a new axis is an event-act only (taking orders, a conversion, a consecration) — ambient faith deepens or erodes what is in you; committing to a god can put something new in you. Best-experience rationale recorded: one chart everywhere, one picker UI, one prose grammar.
- **§800.4 OWNER RULING (verbatim intent) — FULL PARADIGM FOR ALL, TOP-3 DISPLAY:** "regarding the cap, you suggest, i think every NPC and god deserves the full paradigm but we only show the top 3 strongest personality traits." **The chair's ≤3 held-axes cap (§800.2) is OVERRULED and the owner's shape is architecturally superior — chair implementation rulings:** **(1) SEMANTICALLY FULL, BYTE-SPARSE:** every NPC and god holds a position on EVERY axis as a matter of MEANING, but a neutral position costs ZERO BYTES — absent-means-neutral is the encoding (the disposition-channel discipline exactly: the full vector is a READ, absent ⇒ 0). Legacy saves stay byte-identical; silence-writes-nothing survives at full-paradigm scale. **(2) THE DISPLACEMENT RECEIPT:** top-3 selection = |position| desc, then band rank, then codepoint axis id (pinned total order); a background axis overtaking a foreground one is a NEW receipt kind — displacement ("bitterness has overtaken his patience") — the visible personality CHANGING is now a first-class, cause-bound event. **(3) WALLPAPER GUARD:** with every axis able to drift, receipts mint ONLY on band crossings, reversals (paradigm shifts), and top-3 displacements — never on raw movement (bandedStock's own anti-wallpaper law). **(4) THE DEPTH GATE BECOMES LOAD-BEARING:** with latent greed in everyone, corruption eligibility MUST read banded depth (marked-or-deeper vice), never mere nonzero — else the whole world is corruptible; §800.2's recommendation is now a REQUIREMENT. **(5) J5 REVISED OUT LOUD** (its held-axes premise is superseded): the acquisition concept DISSOLVES — ambient milieu/faith pull touches ALL axes at small per-axis learn rates toward the field's poles; commitment events (taking orders, conversion, consecration) remain the LARGE targeted pushes. A gentle man in a cruel city can now be slowly seeded with cruelty — expressible, believable, and bounded by the same anti-ratchet walk home. **(6) GENERATION:** rolled NPCs get salient positions from the existing dominant/flaw/modifier draw mapped onto axes, all else neutral — the current generator is the special case, unchanged in distribution until the doors light.

- **§802 OWNER SITTING II (verbatim intent) + CHAIR RULINGS:** (a) "are the npcs agentic enough?"; (b) "if their flaws or vices get too bad to extreme or too crowded, they may willingly seek to be compromised for more power because it does have its own benefits, though of course whoever they seek can refuse if that person's character is known to them"; (c) "the personalities of NPC should also follow the rumor mill even in their own settlement with appropriate varying levles of belief attributed to them based on past actions"; (d) "if we have goals and missions for NPCs, they should have various ways of accomplishing said goals and mission that reinforce or diminish appropriate parts of their disposition." **Rulings (each vetoable): R1 — WILLING COMPROMISE (demand-side corruption):** eligibility = a corruptible vice at `defining` OR vice crowding (≥2 vices at `marked`+); emits a `seek_compromise` candidate through npcAgency's EXISTING candidate grammar toward a typed patron menu (criminal faction · corrupt seat-holder · corruption web/foreign patron · corrupting cult — all existing structures); acceptance is a REAL REFUSAL (the ⟨F8⟩ vetting pattern) reading the seeker's KNOWN character (R2), tolerance set by the patron's own character/doctrine; a granted seek enters the SAME corruption state (leash/ties) — a second door, never a parallel system; refusal is receipted (whether humiliation teaches bitterness = owner-taste row). **R2 — KNOWN CHARACTER (the reputation read model):** perceived character = a PURE DERIVED read over the receipted subset only — on-record acts (revealed corruption, lie-stigma, custody, band crossings/displacements that made news) propagated through the EXISTING rumor/news mill (distance-priced; same-settlement fastest), per-observer belief = subject's track record (credibility stock × revealed states) × the observer's own TRUST-axis position. Unreceipted drift stays PRIVATE — the town knows the reeve hardened; the quiet clerk's treachery surprises. No second personality store. ⭐ **THE SIGHT RULING: mortal consumers (R1 refusals, patrons, courts) read KNOWN character; DEITIES read TRUE character** (targetedFootholds keeps true-sight) — gods know souls, men know reputations; believable and it preserves the existing foothold behavior byte-for-byte. **R3 — PRAXIS (you become what you repeatedly do):** each goal/mission carries a typed METHOD MENU from the existing action grammar (suppress/reform/bargain/expose/sabotage/…); choice is seeded, weighted by effective character atop archetype; each method carries a PRACTICE lesson — small, method-aligned, OUTCOME-INDEPENDENT (the cruel act marks you whether it worked) — distinct from the §800 personal-plane OUTCOME lesson; contrary-to-nature methods are choosable at penalty weight and hold a STRAINED position only while practiced (equilibrium: practice rate balances homeward decay — stop, and you drift home). **R0 — the agentic-enough verdict (assessment, in chat):** structurally yes (goals, evolution, culmination, careers, a bounded action grammar, consequences), characterologically not until this program lands — §§800–802 are precisely the conversion; after them, NPCs are as agentic as the finite-semantics law permits: wanting, choosing in character, seeking power, refusing, reputed, and shaped by their own methods — with every step receipted. docs/DESIGN_W_LIVES.md §12 amended in this act.
- **§802 R4 (owner, same sitting, verbatim intent):** "mechanics where an NPC that was compromsied could have a change of heart before exposure, yet still be bound because of that compromise... how does that work? is it blackmail? are they still compromised or is it something else entirely? their past actions should still follow them but it is an emergent new situation." **CHAIR RULING — THE BOND TRANSMUTES; THE STATE PERSISTS; NOTHING NEW IS STORED:** the corruption tie is one state with a DERIVED bond kind read from state × effective character: vice at the door ⇒ **`appetite`** (they want this — eager compliance); the same tie held while the character has crossed home past the threshold (the §800 reversal, drift's homeward walk) ⇒ **`duress`** — and YES, duress IS blackmail made mechanical: the patron's leverage shifts from the seeker's desire to the patron's MONOPOLY ON THE RECEIPTS of what was already done (the R2 known-character asymmetry is the blackmail's substance — the town may know them as good while the patron alone holds the truth). Behavior forks on the bond kind, all through existing machinery: under duress, corrupt OUTPUT drops to minimal compliance (they stop feeding the ladder), patron-punitive EXPOSURE risk rises (spending the evidence is the patron's counter — spite is receipted), and NEW agency candidates open: **confess** (voluntary self-exposure — takes the full stigma, breaks the hold; past actions follow them even reformed — the tragedy is honest), **seek_protection** (a rival power, the law, sanctuary — a FAITH door), **flip** (turn on the patron — feeds the espionage/exposure arc). Re-corruption is automatic and free: drift back across the threshold ⇒ the read returns `appetite`. No new ledger, no authored flag — the emergent situation the owner named is a DERIVATION over state that already exists plus drift, which is why it can only arise in play and never be written by hand.
- **§802.1 OWNER RATIFICATION + QUESTION (verbatim intent):** "there of course needs to be weighted rolls on everything if left undisterbed by player or user, but the question is do we have weighted rolls regarding their method help shape the weighted roll of success or failure? because then we would have to code that in regarding what the mission is, who else if involved, and all of the related context.... you know what... I like that, what do you think?" **CHAIR RULING — METHOD-CONDITIONED RESOLUTION (R3b), ratified with the cost bounded:** without it the method menu is cosmetic and praxis a self-marking wheel; with it, method choice is REAL choice. The contract: success = base odds (typed goal/mission) × three bounded term families — **actor fit** (method alignment with effective character + capability modifiers: the deceitful lie BETTER — skill-through-vice is deliberate), **counterparty fit** (threaten the cowardly, never the brave; bargain with the greedy), **context** (EXISTING causal variables ONLY — security, legitimacy, prosperity, corruption climate, disposition bands; the source-qualification law transposed: no context state is ever minted for odds). ⭐ **CHOOSE ON KNOWN, RESOLVE ON TRUE:** the actor WEIGHS the method against the counterparty's R2 KNOWN character, but the roll RESOLVES against TRUE character — decisions on estimates, resolutions on truth (the fidelityNoise doctrine, and the sight ruling's mortal half; misjudging a target because their reputation lied is an OUTCOME the actor earned). **Failure modes differ by method** — the richer half: a failed bargain costs standing; a failed threat mints a feud; failed sabotage mints EVIDENCE (→ known character); method choice is a risk-profile choice, not an odds slider. All rolls seeded per (actor, goal, tick) fork; odds reach prose as BAND WORDS never percentages (L5). **THE COST IS BOUNDED BY THE CLOSED GRAMMAR:** the action vocabulary is ~14 verbs and goals/missions are typed, so the whole matrix is verbs × three term families — each verb declares which axes read for actor fit, which for counterparty fit, which causal variables weigh — an authorable, auditable table, NOT open-world coding; it joins the owner-taste registers pack. New enumerated loop (§9): competence-through-practice (success → practice → deeper axis → better odds → chosen more), bounded by saturation, homeward decay, counterparty/context terms, and per-method failure modes. Volume §12 R3b folded this act.
- **§802.2 OWNER REFINEMENT (verbatim intent):** "more success with a chosen method reinforces personality drift which may increase liklihood of it being chosen again down the line with a higher weight, failure isthe opposite effect, all of this being complicated by drift and core personality." **CHAIR RULING — THE TWO-CHANNEL COMPOSITION (R3c), refining R3 rather than discarding it:** every executed method teaches through TWO channels — the **practice mark** (small, method-aligned, outcome-independent: you DID the cruel thing; R3 stands) and the **outcome lesson** (larger, SIGNED by result: success VALIDATES — "this is who I am and it works" — deepening the aligned axis hard; failure CHASTENS — pulling back toward core on that axis). Under success both align ⇒ strong reinforcement; under failure they oppose and the chastening rate dominates ⇒ net drift away exactly as the owner rules — but a residue of the act remains: **a failed atrocity does not leave you clean**, which is the psychological truth R3's independence encoded. **NO PARALLEL HABIT LEDGER:** selection weight reads EFFECTIVE CHARACTER only — the drift IS the habit memory (one source per fact; a per-verb habit stock would double-count and could diverge from the soul). Consequence, ruled a FEATURE: reinforcement GENERALIZES across same-axis methods — success at lying makes manipulation likelier too; habits generalize by character, not by verb. **THE CORE-STRAIN ASYMMETRY (the owner's "complicated by drift and core," emergent from ruled arithmetic, zero new machinery):** core-aligned habits are SELF-SUSTAINING (decay pulls toward core, working with them); contrary-to-nature habits hold a STRAINED position that homeward decay constantly erodes — the gentle man who discovers he is good at threats stays formidable only while he keeps making them, and the moment he stops, he goes home. **STABILITY:** failure's chastening is the negative-feedback BRAKE the §802.1 competence loop lacked — odds are never certain, failures land, weight and drift both fall — so the system self-regulates around a character-odds equilibrium instead of ratcheting. Volume R3c folded this act.

- **§803.1 OWNER SITTING III (verbatim intent) + CHAIR RULINGS:** "they could seek to be more or could seek to be less which goes into refusal or acceptanace and ambition in any form does not only mean compromise position, it could mean accepting riskier but more paying out missions and goals. But of course, they also have a risk register as well. Lastly, their combination of peronalitiy traits should also derive their alignment from good x evil to chaotic x lawful and that chaotic x lawful determines how broad their risk register is for any of their goals." **R5 — THE BIDIRECTIONAL SEEKING ECONOMY:** ambition is a spectrum of DOORS, not the corruption door alone — seek-MORE expresses as high-risk/high-payout mission acceptance, promotion/rivalry bids (ladder machinery), R1 willing compromise, rooted-dwell extension (gather-or-govern already prices it); seek-LESS expresses as refusing missions/promotions, withdrawal toward modest goal branches, and R4's confession/seek_protection exits — ALL through the ONE vetting/acceptance seam, so every door reads the same soul. **R6 — THE PERSONAL RISK REGISTER, DERIVED NEVER STORED:** `riskRegister(npc, context) = {center, breadth}` — center from effective character (the courage/ambition families + the ES charter's home-desperation context term: §3.4b's "temperament × flaws × home-desperation" FORMALIZED), breadth per R8; NO stored risk stock — drift IS the memory (one source per fact). ⭐ THE TWO-SCALE SEAM, stated so nobody double-counts: the COURT's SP-C appetite (learned from campaign outcomes) governs what the court OFFERS; the PERSON's register governs what they ACCEPT — a mission happens when both say yes, and each refusal is in character. **R7 — DERIVED ALIGNMENT:** an NPC's good↔evil × lawful↔chaotic alignment = the summed plane projection of their EFFECTIVE positions (the W-LIVES derived columns), banded into words — alignment is never stored and MOVES WITH DRIFT ("he was a good man once" becomes mechanical: a paradigm shift can flip the read); legacy undrifted words project to today's TRAIT_ALIGNMENT values (the derived-columns pin ⇒ byte-identical); symmetric with deities (axes authored, characterizations derived — one philosophy both scales). **R8 — CHAOS IS BREADTH:** the disorder projection sets the register's WINDOW WIDTH — lawful ⇒ narrow (only well-priced risks accepted), chaotic ⇒ broad (the desperate gambit and the irrational fold both live inside the window; seeded draw over it). ⭐ The owner has INDEPENDENTLY CONVERGED on the estate's own fidelityNoise law (chaos = variance, ratified at settlement scale in W-F4b) at the personal scale — ruled as WINDOW WIDTH v1; extending personal chaos into ESTIMATE noise (the fidelityNoise mechanism itself) is flagged owner-taste to avoid double-noise. Volumes folded this act (W-LIVES §13; W-OPS acceptance note).
- **§803.2 OWNER COHERENCE AUDIT (verbatim intent: "i want this system to be fully coherent, do you think that we are missing anything for it to be fully coherent?") — THE CHAIR'S COMPLETENESS PASS: four genuine gaps found and RULED, two deliberate exclusions RECORDED, one small rule stated.** **GAP A — THE INTERPERSONAL COUPLING (ruled):** the system read character against settlements, factions, gods, and missions but not against NAMED OTHERS — yet relationship machinery exists (relationshipMemory on the banded-stock family, grievances, relationshipEvolution/relationshipRoles). Ruled: relationship events are EXPERIENCE KINDS with the counterpart id as evidence (betrayal BY A FRIEND is a PERSONAL-plane lesson and hits harder than an institutional loss — closest-plane extended: the persons you love are closer than the factions you serve); character CONDITIONS relationship formation through the same projection (the paranoid bond slowly, the warm bond fast); no new relationship system — the coupling only. **GAP B — DEATH AND THE FATE OF STATE (ruled):** drift state is GARBAGE-COLLECTED at death (uid-keyed sweep); KNOWN character FREEZES into legacy at the chronicle (a dead man's reputation persists and can still shame or shield his house); R4 bonds resolve BY HOLDER — evidence shared with an org survives the patron and passes to it (the hold outlives the man), evidence held personally DIES WITH HIM (release — receipted as deliverance); goals die, feud-bearing grievances already follow the existing machinery. **GAP C — GROUP CHARACTER = DERIVED MEMBER PROJECTION (ruled):** the clergy plane GENERALIZES — a faction/court's effective character is the org-power-weighted projection of its seated members (readClergyPlane's exact shape, applied beyond clergy; variance preserved; zero new state); consumed beside — never instead of — SP-C's learned appetite (the three-reads seam: the court's NERVE is learned, its CHARACTER is who staffs it, its OFFERS read both); a faction's R2 known character is its public face. **GAP D — BIOGRAPHY IS A QUERY, NOT A STORE (ruled):** an NPC's life story = a derived read over the receipts that name them (crossings, reversals, displacements, custody, exposures — all evidence-bound already); the dossier renders "hardened by the sack, the failed mission, a year in a cruel city" from receipts alone; NO per-NPC memory store exists or may be minted. **DELIBERATE EXCLUSIONS (recorded so nobody re-finds them as gaps):** NO mood/emotion layer — character + context + conditions cover it, a fast affect sim is out of scope by design; NO age-scaled drift rates in v1 (the young drifting faster is a TASTE ROW, not a hole). **SMALL RULE:** the AFFILIATION plane's "your god" resolves: clergy → their faction's deity; laity → the settlement patron scaled by devotion. Verdict delivered in chat: with A–D ruled, the chair finds the design CLOSED under its own laws — every loop enumerated and braked, every state one-sourced, every claim receipted, every surface fed.

- **§810 OWNER DIRECTIVE (verbatim intent, three messages) — TIER-GATED FACTION & NPC DENSITY, ROLLED NEVER HARDCODED:** "we need to disperse and make appropriately variable the amount of factions and NPCs. for example, a thorpe maybe should have one faction and that is whoever is in the ruling seat, maybe another of the ruling seat is not the most influential. So two at most if that makes sense upon generation. A town should have multiple factions, maybe one per each power in the ranking with one to two NPCs in it. A city to a metropolis for example should have multiple factions, maybe two different factions in some select powers, with each having 2-3 or a full suite of NPCs. But we should have this appropriately distributed and gated by tier." + "not hardcoded but the range for the roll is gated appropriately to correspond to the scale" + "for the thorpe maybe only one named NPC as an example rather than a full suite of NPC for a faction." **CHAIR RULINGS (each vetoable): R1 — THE ROLL-RANGE PRINCIPLE:** nothing is a constant — every count is a SEEDED ROLL within a TIER-GATED RANGE; the tier gates the range, the roll supplies variance, and the settlement's particulars (prosperity, trade connectivity, war state, corruption climate) tilt the weights WITHIN the range — a poor town may roll like a village, a rich crossroads village like a town; deterministic per seed. **R2 — THE ONE-PERSON FACTION IS A FEATURE:** at thorp scale a faction may be ONE named NPC — the seat-holder IS the polity — and under W-LIVES that person's character arc becomes the town's entire politics (the spotlight concentrates exactly where legibility and perf both want it). **R3 — THE CONDITIONAL SECOND FACTION:** the thorp's +1 exists precisely when the influence ranking's top power ≠ the ruling power — the gap between throne and influence IS the story, so the roll manufactures drama only where the world already implies it. **R4 — INTRA-POWER RIVALS AT CITY+** (two factions in one power niche) reuse the PANTHEON NICHE-CONTEST pattern (multiple claimants contesting one niche with shares) — no new contest machinery. **R5 — THE PROMISE IS KEPT BY VERSIONING:** this changes generation distributions, so it lands as a VERSIONED GENERATION LAW (the layoutLawVersion pattern — existing worlds keep their version verbatim; new worlds roll the new ladder); the LADDER VALUES are TUNING ROWS under the owner's tuning signature at the tuning pass (tuning-is-last law) — the machinery is chartered NOW (TE-DENSITY-1: the versioned parameter set + roll plumbing + fixtures), the numbers are signed LAST. **R6 — CENSUS FIRST:** before any freeze, measure the CURRENT per-tier faction/NPC distributions across the fixture corpus AND sweep the count-sensitive consumers with a full denominator (seatNpcsIntoFactions · presentShare01's bench math · ORG_POWER's minor=0 floor · faction capture · contest weights) — density moves their inputs and each must be dispositioned. Candidate ladder (ROLL RANGES, tuning-signed later): thorp 1 faction (+1 per R3) × 1 named NPC · hamlet 1–2 × 1–2 · village 2–3 × 1–2 · town one-per-ranked-power (3–5) × 1–2 · city 5–8 incl. 1–2 doubled niches × 2–3 · metropolis 7–10 incl. doubled niches × 2–3 with full suites on select pillars. Register VII added to the pack this act.
- **§810.1 OWNER EXTENSION (verbatim intent):** "as tiers grow, more factions may join in and more NPCs per appropriate faction where appropriate as weighted by the influence ranking, legitimacy, economics, etc." **CHAIR RULINGS: R7 — DENSITY IS ALIVE, ONE LAW FOR BIRTH AND GROWTH:** the SAME Register VII roll ranges govern generation AND simulated tier promotion — when a settlement crosses a tier boundary, the political fabric THICKENS toward the new tier's band at a slow rolled cadence (one emergence per interval, never an instant sprout: a promoted town grows its politics the way it grew its walls), each event receipted and Herald-worthy contextual news ("a weavers' house rises among the town's powers"). **R8 — REPRESENTATION FOLLOWS INFLUENCE (the thorp rule generalized):** §810 R3's conditional second faction was the seed of the general law — at every tier, the spawn roll fills the LARGEST REPRESENTATION GAP first: a power strong in the influence ranking / legitimacy / economics but carrying no faction (or an under-crewed one) is where the new faction or the new named NPC lands; the weights are exactly the owner's list. New named members roll their characters through the W-LIVES generation path and enter the AFFILIATION plane live. **R9 — SYMMETRY IS MANDATORY (the anti-ratchet law applied to politics):** density also THINS on tier decline — the weakest-standing faction folds, merges, or goes to exile first, receipted as drama ("the guild hall stands empty") — because one-way thickening is a RATCHET and a settlement that grew then shrank would keep metropolis politics forever; the estate's proven killer, refused structurally. Owner may veto the shrink arm. All three ride TE-DENSITY-1's versioned generation law (§810 R5); growth-side dynamics are versioned identically (old worlds keep old dynamics verbatim). Register VII annotated this act.
- **§810.2 OWNER CORRECTION + EXTENSION (verbatim intent):** "a thorpe could have multiple, maybe two NPCs maybe three all in the ruling power or dispersed about mulitile factions in the thorpe. but i don't want it to always be one random faction gets a full suite of three NPCs consistetn every time. it needs variance and believability. and also take into consideration the starting influence or position of each NPC in a faction. maybe they don't have a head priest but someone taht yearns to be promoted to there or they have no lowest level position NPC. truly add believable variety." **The chair's Register VII thorp row (1×1) is CORRECTED — it was a constant wearing a range's clothes. CHAIR RULINGS: R10 — THE TWO-STAGE ROLL (mass, then dispersal):** roll the settlement's named-NPC MASS within the tier band (thorp 1–3), then DISPERSE it across factions by a second seeded weighted partition — all-in-the-ruling-power, spread-one-each, and everything between all reachable, weights tilted by the influence ranking so concentration FOLLOWS power without ever being determined by it. **ANTI-DEGENERACY IS TESTED, NOT HOPED:** a distribution-shape fixture over many seeds asserts real entropy in the dispersal patterns at every tier (no single pattern may dominate) — per the walker-census law, the pattern SPACE is covered, since a shape the corpus never produces looks clean. **R11 — ROSTERED RUNGS WITH AUTHORED VACANCIES:** a faction's roster rolls RUNG OCCUPANCY, not headcount — head / middle / lowest, ANY rung may be vacant at birth — and ⭐ the VACANCY-PLUS-YEARNER pattern (no head priest, but one who aches for the seat) is deliberately over-weighted because it is the best story the generator can plant: the vacancy registers in the EXISTING ladder machinery as an open window, and the yearner arrives with seek_promotion pre-loaded through the existing goal system — generation hands the agency layer a wound-up spring, zero new machinery. **Rank ceilings scale with tier** (a thorp's head is at most notable; no pillars below town — importance bands map to rungs), and vacancy weights tilt by particulars (a poor or shrinking place runs understaffed; a prosperous one fills its benches). Register VII re-drafted this act; all §810 rulings' versioning/tuning gates apply unchanged.
- **§810.2(b) OWNER, same sitting (verbatim intent):** "and that scales to all tiers" + "but again... even with the thorpe example, the range has to be believable." **CHAIR:** R10/R11 apply at EVERY tier — mass-then-dispersal and rung-vacancy rolls are the ONE generation shape, tier only sets the bands — and **THE BELIEVABILITY ENVELOPE IS THE BAND'S EDGE:** a range's endpoints are themselves believability assertions (a thorp can NEVER roll seven named figures; a metropolis never rolls two) — variance lives INSIDE the plausible and structurally cannot leave it; the roll explores the envelope, the envelope is owner-signed at the tuning pass, and the distribution-shape fixture asserts coverage WITHIN the band and zero mass OUTSIDE it. Register VII re-drafted as mass bands across all tiers this act.
- **§810.3 OWNER HARD GATE (verbatim intent):** "one hard gate to all of this... there still must always be one named NPC for a faction in the ruling seat of the settlement. someone has to run something. That is of course unless the settlement in generated in a stressor about a missing ruling seat." **CHAIR RULINGS: R12 — THE SEAT FLOOR:** the mass-dispersal roll is CONSTRAINT-FIRST — the first named NPC always mints INTO the ruling power's faction (someone runs something), and only then does the remaining mass disperse; the floor holds on EVERY generation path (create and regen alike — the lifecycle law). **R13 — THE EXCEPTION IS TYPED, NEVER ACCIDENTAL:** the floor lifts ONLY under a closed missing-ruling-seat generation stressor (interregnum · succession dispute · the seat's holder taken by the founding calamity — riding the existing generation-stressor vocabulary where it exists, minted typed in TE-DENSITY-1 where it does not) — and the rulerless birth is then §810.2's VACANCY-PLUS-YEARNER pattern applied to the THRONE itself: claimants pre-loaded through the heir archetype and the ladder's open window, so a settlement born without a ruler is born INTO a succession story, not into a null. - **§810.4 OWNER RULINGS (verbatim intent):** "if there is a power that has more influence than the ruling faction, not bounded in blood, but a stronger weighted roll that that power gains a faction and at least one NPC. remember, if a faction is generated, it must be paired with atleast one NPC. there are no NPC-less factions at all. it gains a STRONGER WEIGHTED ROLL, the weight scaling with the influence gap, open to ANY power archetype ("not bounded in blood" — wealth, faith, and arms qualify on their own standing, no dynastic tie required); the §810.2 anti-degeneracy fixture covers this roll too (sometimes the out-influenced throne stands unchallenged — that too is a world). **R17 — THE ATOMIC MINT:** a faction and its first named NPC are ONE generation act — a faction mints WITH ≥1 NPC or does not mint at all; NPC-less factions are unrepresentable at birth on every generation path. **R18 — ROSTER-BOUND EXISTENCE (the live half):** in simulation, a faction whose named roster reaches ZERO (death, exile, departure) CEASES TO EXIST — dissolution is an event with a chronicle receipt and Herald-grade contextual news ("the last factor of the weavers' house took the north road; the house is no more"); per the GAP-B pattern, history stays (grudges in the pair ledger decay on their own clocks; receipts persist), live state is swept — no orphaned machinery. **R19 — THE JUNCTION (where R18 meets the §810.3 seat floor):** the ruling faction emptying is the ONE case that may not dissolve into nothing — "someone must run something" — so an emptied ruling roster becomes a TYPED INTERREGNUM condition (the R13 missing-seat stressor arising IN PLAY rather than at birth): the succession machinery engages (heirs, claimants, the ladder's open window, §810.2's vacancy-and-yearner at the throne), and the interregnum is a receipted, bounded story-state, never a silent null. **R20 — THE INVARIANT WIDENS:** §810.3 R15's walker now asserts over EVERY faction at EVERY tick: roster ≥1, OR the faction is the ruling one in typed interregnum, OR it dissolved with its receipt — no fourth state. The census lane's zero-NPC-faction measurements are now load-bearing for ALL factions. Pack annotated in the same act.

New NPCs roll their characters through the W-LIVES generation path and enter the planes live; the ascension lands as an AFFILIATION-plane lesson on the house (the experience table's house family, rose-heavy). - **§810.7 OWNER CLARIFICATION (verbatim intent): "succession events are tied to title/position of the NPC and not just faction."** **CHAIR RULING — R22, SUCCESSION IS TITULAR:** a succession event binds to the TITLE/POSITION vacated — the ruling seat, a faction's head rung, any named office — never to the faction as a blob. Consequences, each falling out of machinery already ruled: **(a)** one vacancy shape at every scale — a dead reeve, a dead high priest, and a dead guildmaster all mint the same open-rung-plus-claimants state, differing only in the CLAIM VOCABULARY (blood/heir where the government form implies it · ladder standing for institutional heads · wealth/arms where the archetype fits — reading the RULING_POWERS-derived forms per Q11); **(b)** a faction PERSISTS through a head vacancy — headless-but-alive is exactly §810.2's vacancy-plus-yearner state arising in play, and R18's dissolution still fires only at roster zero; **(c)** §810.5's ruling-seat stressor is the title-scoped case of the ONE titular-succession family, not a sibling system; **(d)** claim weights read the world already built — government form, heir ties, ladder standing, faction standing, the claimant's character through the seek machinery, and the KNOWN character the court weighs (R2); multiple claimants = the existing rivalry/bid machinery, and outcomes teach through the career lesson family. Titles are typed by the rung vocabulary + the seat; no new succession engine — the ladder, the stressor family, and the vacancy pattern compose it whole.
- **§810.8 OWNER RULING (verbatim intent): "succession events should end with either a rebellion, coup, etc that completely overthrows the ruling seat (factions and all) or with the promotion of someone esle in that faction if they exist or if another faction/power simply takes over because they legitimacy and challenged and won against the current faction or power."** **CHAIR RULING — R23, THE CLOSED RESOLUTION GRAMMAR (three outcome families for the ruling seat, finite-semantics through and through):** **CONTINUITY** — internal promotion: the house holds, the ladder/heir/yearner machinery seats a new head under §810.7's claim vocabulary (favored when the roster has depth and viable claimants); **TRANSFER** — a rival power/faction with a legitimacy case CHALLENGES AND WINS: lawful passage of the seat, and ⭐ the defeated ruling faction SURVIVES DEMOTED — not destroyed — carrying house_power_fell lessons, grudges, and the possibility of revanche (the difference between transfer and overthrow is whether the old house lives, and that difference is where decades of story come from); **OVERTHROW** — rebellion/coup seizes the seat and removes the old ruling faction ENTIRELY ("factions and all"): scattered, exiled, or destroyed through R18's own roster-emptying roads (a forced end is receipted like any other), the victor ascending via §810.6's materialization where factionless (the coup machinery already in the tree serves this family). **R24 — RESOLUTION IS AN ARC WITH A GUARANTEED END:** the succession stressor persists while claimants maneuver through the EXISTING agency grammar (undermine_rival, bargain, mobilize, expose — every move a lesson), and play may settle it early (a claimant prevails, a coup fires, a challenge lands); the stressor carries a RESOLUTION CLOCK, and at its end the weighted roll settles what play did not — weights read house depth, the legitimacy/influence gap, settlement disposition and stability, war state, and the claimants' characters and risk registers. A succession that never resolves is a hole, not a story; termination is structural. **R25 — SCALE-DOWN:** institutional titles (guild head, temple head) resolve with the reduced family — internal promotion · external poach/absorption · vacancy-persists-toward-dissolution — the realm-scale outcomes (rebellion, legitimacy transfer of the SEAT) belong to the ruling title alone. Legitimacy formulae remain untouched readers (the charter's line holds); every outcome lands its lessons, its grudges, and its Herald narrative through existing writers.

§890.2 · **THE WALL CLOCK LEAVES THE REGIONAL SEAMS, AND THE CAR TURNED OUT TO BE A CLASS RATHER THAN TWO SITES.** Two cars at **`03da380abf4e860c4cf81182e59e1b7caababb82`**, sealed `refs/preserve/nownull-2026-09-03` — **unreferenced when the lane reported, the seventh payout of the survival law today.** 15 paths, all modifications, no new test file. `now: null` now means **"no stamp"** at both regional seams and all 20 outstanding threading sites are done. ⭐⭐ **But the lane's own focused test caught a regression it had just introduced, and that is the real finding:** the estate's universal spelling for "no pinned instant" was **free while `null` and `undefined` were interchangeable and becomes a bug the moment they diverge** — cured at four further sites. ⚠⚠ **And every other arm of the clock-seam walker is structurally BLIND to it:** one counts clock reads (a flattening adds none), one reads call arguments (this lives in a parameter list), one runs pinned paths (this never executes there). **A guard family can be complete against the defect it was built for and unable to see the defect its own cure creates.** ⭐ **THE MIGRATION QUESTION WAS ANSWERED BETTER THAN IT WAS ASKED.** The owner's pre-launch directive is in-tree — but the lane found, and the chair verified by its own read, that the chain is `row.stamp || resolveStamp(now)`, so **a stored row that already carries a stamp short-circuits and never reaches the resolver.** ⇒ **every persisted campaign is byte-unchanged and no migration is owed whether or not saves exist.** An argument that survives the loss of its premise is worth more than one that rests on it. **The strict bill was one lying annotation, not four defects:** a generic constrained as `updatedAt?: string` made TypeScript fall back to the constraint and red all four sites at once; §890.3 · **O-17 LANDS — AND THE CHAIR RETRACTS A FINDING IT REPORTED TO THE OWNER.** ⛔⛔ **THE RETRACTION FIRST.** The chair told the owner that **`pg` is not in `package.json` at all**, and called it a fragility that would stop a fresh clone running the landing gate. **FALSE.** It is declared at `package.json:119` in devDependencies, `^8.22.0`, on both branches — and the O-17 lane said so in its own report. ⭐⭐ **HOW THE FALSE CLAIM WAS MANUFACTURED, because the mechanism matters more than the fact:** the probe was `node -e "…" 2>/dev/null || echo "not in package.json at all"`. The node call **failed**, `2>/dev/null` **hid the error**, and the `||` fallback **printed a confident finding in its place.** ⇒ **the THIRD false statement today produced by a swallowed error.** ⛔ **THE LAW AT FULL STRENGTH: A FALLBACK BRANCH MUST NEVER PRINT A FINDING.** `|| echo "<a claim>"` converts an unexplained failure into evidence. §912.2 · **THE OWNER RULES THAT THE RULES ARE THE EXEMPLAR, NOT THE PRACTICAL — "all the laws that you made are the exemplar not the practical… the variance between what is ideal and what is lacking is in itself something organic and human"; "we shoot for the ideal in every first or second attempt, but we do not have to pursue perfection. the pursuit of perfection will always get in the way of what is perfect in my mind. so yes i agree with you. first find the laws that cannot and should not be muted, then build a rule or rational for a maximum number of laws that can be broken (the floor) and of course for each law broken a floor from how far it was broken"; then "do it." (2026-09-07 ~17:55, ~18:10, ~18:20, verbatim).** ✅ RULED 2026-09-07: **THE PRINCIPLE (the owner's law):** RULES-V2 Parts A and B and the two specs are a REGISTER the writing is measured against, never a template it must hit; compliance is a DISTRIBUTION, not a point; the writer aims at the ideal on the first or second attempt and does not chase it after; deviation of FORM inside a band is lawful, organic and expected; only the WALLS are hard. **THE MECHANISM (the chair's refinement, adopted by the owner's "do it"; the three numbers stay the owner's):** (1) WALLS, never muted — every sentence licensed by a typed field (the Brackwater lesson, Part B §9); B-CLAIM (a rewrite spends no claim, modality, threat class or pool spread); THE PROMISE (seed inputs, index 0, pool length — A7/A17); sibling coherence in structural fact (CLERK-LAWS C5); no digits (A4) and no em dashes (B-DASH) in prose; product scope (never a named character's fate); deity doctrine; the audience law (the record never addresses the reader); the archivist voice never on chrome (CC-1); public and paid copy owner-signed. (2) BANDS — every soft rule's Figure is a BAND whose lawful RANGE and lawful DEVIATION RATE are taken from the fourteen exemplar fingerprints (the best human records' own measured imperfection — e.g. martin-chronicle's triad rate 0.2129), so the budget and the depths are MEASURED, never invented; distance is counted in band-widths outside the band, comparable across rules; every "→ ≤ x" size in Part B §1–§6 is henceforth the band's edge with its distance reported. (3) THREE NUMBERS, the owner's, recommended by the chair from the fingerprints at the same sitting as Q4/Q5/Q15: the BUDGET (how many soft rules one ENTRY — the unit a reader meets — may exceed), the DEPTH (how many band-widths outside on any one rule), the PERFECTION CEILING (a pool or tab inside every band with zero deviation is flagged suspect — no human record sits at zero; the owner's idea, the part the rulebook lacked). (4) SPREAD — the walker reports WHICH rules are broken across a pool and a tab; the same rule broken the same way everywhere is the template again (uniform imperfection is a tell). (5) CHANNELS — the walker's FAIL channel is for walls; a soft rule REPORTS its distance and fails only past the depth, the budget or the ceiling; the rewrite brief says "write to the register"; the refuter brief says "refute claim changes, never form inside the band"; the blind DM panel judges whether the mix reads human. (6) The machine's signatures (best-ai: the summarising second sentence, the tricolon, the gloss tail, the evaluative close) are NOT the human kind of variance — their lawful rate is the exemplars' measured rate for that shape, never a licence. **Why it was needed:** the first taste cut lost claims by writing to the rule instead of to the register (SITTING-RULINGS §H; the refuter's findings); "a threshold hit exactly IS the fault" (kay:44) was in the rules and not in the philosophy. Every alias therefore carries a **proof** — a file and a string that must still be present in the live corpus — and the proof is **executed on every run**, not left as a comment: `ALIAS_PROOF_ROTTED` when the string is gone, `ALIAS_PROOF_FILE_MISSING` when the file is, `ALIAS_TARGET_MISSING` when a combined-header alias names a target that is not itself a real opener, and `DEAD_ALIAS` when an aliased number has since gained one. **Silencing a genuine dangling citation costs a code change that reds, never a baseline edit.**

## §923 · THE PREFIX GATE IS INSTALLED — §883.5(c)'s HIGH CURE, RATIFIED AT §892 AND OPEN SINCE 2026-09-02, WITH FIVE PLANTED CONTROLS EXECUTED AND A SECOND ARM THE RECORD NEVER HAD (2026-09-14; SEAT: Opus 5 — Fable-unvalidated; LONG TAIL #42, car 4)

- **§923.1 THE GAP IS CLOSED.** §883.5(c) found three copies of `docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md` on disk, two of them stale, and recorded that `chair-commit.sh` maps by whichever path it is handed *"silently and without comparison"* — so appending to the stale one *"would have landed a commit that silently DELETED four strata while passing every gate this program owns."* §892 **RATIFIED** the cure and recorded it **still not installed**: `grep -ci prefix` returned **0** in all five preserved toolkits and in the live copy. It now returns **10**. `chair-commit.sh` md5 **`de222d72e6fde3be2a4d443a0a057599` → `700161aecea509c0cbe5cad2d0a34fa1`** (+70 lines, one file).
- **§923.2 WHY EVERY EXISTING GATE WAS BLIND, IN ONE SENTENCE.** Both existing arms — §688.7's "presence is not a row" and §882.14's enrolment check — ask only whether the blob **DIFFERS** from the parent's. ⭐ **A regression differs.** The new gate asks the different question: does the source **CONTAIN the parent as a byte PREFIX**? A truncation, a stale copy, a mid-file edit and a reordering all fail it; a genuine append passes. The comparison is `head -c <parent size> | git hash-object --stdin` against the parent blob's sha, i.e. the same comparison git itself would make.
- **§923.3 ⭐ IT COVERS BOTH APPEND-ONLY FILES, NOT ONLY THE ONE THE RECORD FOUND.** `docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md` is read **unconditionally from the main checkout's working tree** at `H=$(git hash-object -w docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md)` and had **no gate of any kind** — in a checkout whose index carries the owner's staged 29,663-line ODQ deletion. That is the arm §883.5(c) never had, and control (iv) below exercises it against the literal live hazard.
- **§923.4 ⚠ ONE PATH DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, RECORDED SO IT IS NOT MISTAKEN FOR AN OVERSIGHT.** `docs/PROVENANCE_MAP.tsv` is **not** in the gate's list. Its **rows** are additive but its documentation header is corrected in place (§922.7), so it is not byte-prefix append-only and the gate would be a permanent false red on it. Its additivity is gated instead by `tests/scripts/provenanceMap.test.js` arm 3, which asserts the row prefix rather than the file prefix.
- **§923.5 THE FIVE PLANTED CONTROLS, EXECUTED, EACH EXIT QUOTED — the §685.4 idiom.** Tip verified **unmoved at `c6cfc8210`** before and after all five.
  - **(i) a retro-queue source that is a REGRESSION** (a 400,000 B stale copy against the parent's 717,032 B) → `ABORT: docs/FABLE_RETROVALIDATION_QUEUE.md SHRANK — 400000 B against the parent's 717032 B (§883.5(c)).` · **EXIT=1**
  - **(ii) an IDENTICAL source** → the existing arm still fires first: `ABORT: the retrovalidation queue is UNCHANGED — presence is not a row.` · **EXIT=1**
  - **(iii) a LEGITIMATE append** (parent + one line) → **passes the prefix gate** and stops at the tip check: `ABORT: tip moved: c6cfc8210… (expected 0000000…)` · **EXIT=1**. ⭐ This is the control that proves the gate is **not a blanket refuser** — without it a gate that refuses everything would look identical to a gate that works.
  - **(iv) the ODQ WORKING-TREE copy as a regression** — truncated to exactly the **223,179 B** its index blob holds today → `ABORT: docs/OWNER_DECISION_QUEUE.md SHRANK — 223179 B against the parent's 3424677 B (§883.5(c)).` · **EXIT=1**. The working-tree copy was restored and verified byte-identical to HEAD by md5 (`62a65c3e7b6f9afd1270eb53026849c1`), and the expected-tip was deliberately bogus as a second safety.
  - **(v) a MID-FILE edit that keeps the byte count** (one byte changed at the halfway point, 717,032 B in and out) → `ABORT: … does not CONTAIN its parent as a byte prefix (§883.5(c), §892).` with both hashes printed · **EXIT=1**. ⭐ **This is the case no size check and no difference check can catch**, and it is why the gate hashes rather than measures.
- **§923.6 ⛔⛔ THE SEAL WAS NOT A SEAL — A FINDING OF THIS CAR, AND IT UNDERCUTS AN ASSUMPTION THE RECORD HAS BEEN MAKING.** `refs/preserve/chair-tools-2026-09-05` is **not frozen**: a live autosave (`autosave-handoff.sh`, PID 20882, running 2 days) **re-points it every cycle** — its tip today is `df802c02a`, *"AUTOSAVE kit 2026-09-14 22:34:52"*, not the 09-05 sealing. The same process moves `refs/preserve/resume-note-2026-09-05` and every `refs/preserve/dock-<name>-live`. ⭐ **A `refs/preserve/*` name is therefore NOT by itself evidence of an immutable seal**, and the standing assumption that a pre-cure copy is "one `git show` away" would have failed here within one autosave cycle. Two **stable** refs were cut instead, under names the autosave never writes: **`refs/preserve/chair-tools-2026-09-14-pre-prefix-gate` = `df802c02a`** (chair-commit.sh md5 `de222d72e…`, the pre-cure copy, frozen) and **`refs/preserve/chair-tools-2026-09-14` = `2eada40ed`** (md5 `700161aec…`, the cured copy; diff against its parent: **one file, +70 lines**).
- **§923.7 ⚠ THE CURE STILL LIVES IN AN UNTRACKED SCRATCHPAD FILE, AND A REBOOT HAS ALREADY DESTROYED THAT DIRECTORY ONCE.** `chair-commit.sh` is not in `git ls-files`; no npm gate covers it; the 2026-09-12 20:08 reboot took the whole kit and it survived only because an autosave had sealed it one minute earlier. **The structural cure for the record's own integrity is itself held only by refs.** Recorded, per the brief, as a known and unclosed exposure — and §923.6 makes it sharper than the brief knew, because the ref that was believed to hold it is a moving target.
- **§923.8 WHAT THIS CAR DOES NOT DO.** It moves **no repo byte** — the tool is untracked — and rules nothing. It moves two preserve refs, which is a shared-tree write, done with explicit `update-ref` and verified by `git for-each-ref`.

- **§934.7 THE SETTLEMENT'S DRAFT ORIGIN IS AN EXPLAINED WRITER — A GOVERNED REGISTER MINT UNDER THE SAME ORDER** (2026-09-18 ~19:5x EDT; seat: the chair, ruling; the mint executed by the gates-store lane). Adversarial review 9 faulted the anonymous-draft design a fourth time (a claim spent at session resolution, a redirect-door stash in sessionStorage, a `signedInWorld` bar raised at sign-out — each patch leaking through the next), and the chair replaced it with ONE RULE: a generated world carries its own origin, `settlement.draftOrigin` = 'anon' when no user is signed in at generation, else 'account'; the persist projection writes the anonymous-draft envelope iff the origin is 'anon' and no user is present; every boot adopts the envelope; a save, bind, hydrate or canonize claims the world ('account'), so it is never again stashed as the device's draft; the claim/stash/drop machinery is DELETED (−636/+568 over ten files, `src/store/anonDraftGate.js` gone). THE REGISTER CONSEQUENCE, ruled here: `draftOrigin on settlement` is a key the observed-shape corpus never sees, because the corpus executes the generation pipeline and the stamp is written by the STORE's generate action after the pipeline returns — a writer the corpus never runs, the class the explained-writer bank exists for. It is minted as an M8/M9 `EXPLAINED_WRITER_EXEMPTIONS` row: mechanism `save-time-writer` (the `worldPulse on campaignState` precedent, a store helper), writer `src/store/settlementGenerateAction.js` (gate 0 proves the write on every scan), ruling this §. The sentinel's declared set and the walker's tag totals move with it by the governed `--write`; no ordinary-debt ceiling is raised, no file added, and the car body records the measured figures. WHY THE KEY LIVES ON THE WORLD and not at the store root: the origin must travel with the world through save, hydrate and canonize, and a root key would take a row in the persisted-key register instead — one register row either way, and the honest one is the world's.
- **§934.8 §934.7 WITHDRAWN BEFORE IT LANDED — THE ORIGIN IS TRANSIENT STORE STATE, NOT A KEY ON THE WORLD** (2026-09-18 ~20:1x EDT; seat: the chair). The mint refused itself: `EXPLAINED_WRITER_EXEMPTIONS` lives inside the content-addressed detector, so adding a row moves the detector digest and the instrument demands a governed migration bundle (`--write --migrate-schema --migration-review=<bundle>`), not the plain `--write` §934.7 prescribed. Reading that refusal exposed the better design: stamping `draftOrigin` on the settlement object is a PERSISTED-SHAPE change (it rides into saves and into the observed-shape corpus) — an owner-gated class the chair should not spend under delegation when an equivalent exists — and the equivalent does: the origin is a store-ROOT field, never partialized, set by every path a world enters through (generate: 'anon' when no user is signed in, else 'account'; rehydrate: 'anon' when the anonymous envelope is adopted, else 'account'; hydrate/bind/save/canonize: 'account'). The envelope rule is unchanged (written iff origin 'anon' and no user; every boot adopts). Consequences: no register moves — the observed-shape baseline stays at its exact 1,966, the sentinel's declared set is untouched, the generated object is byte-identical to the pipeline's, and the immer read-only hazard at the hydrate door disappears with the object spread. The gates-store lane rebuilds car 4 to this ruling; §934.7 stands in the ledger as the ruling it was, superseded here.
