- **§934.20 THE PICTURE AND THE FIGURE ARE FED FROM ONE FIELD — the food bar, then every chart (2026-09-19 ~05:2x EDT; the owner's finding; an Opus lane builds).** The owner attached the Economics tab's food balance bar for a world at need 1,014 lbs/day, production 773, "+ 169 imported": the bar draws production (76%), imports (17%) and a beige tail of 7%, while the sentence beneath it says "Residual shortfall is 4%". The arithmetic: production plus imports is 942, 92.9% of need, so the drawn tail is honest; the sentence's 4% is true only because the food writer applies a THIRD channel — the magic food offset (druidic 0.65 / divine 0.4 / arcane 0.3 of what trade leaves uncovered) — which the bar never draws and the sentence never names. §934.15 cured the arithmetic; this is the same class one layer up: a chart's segments and its stated figures fed from different fields. ORDER (the owner's: "the attached visual's gap does not look like it represents a 96% coverage. can you check on any other charts as well?"): (1) the food bar draws every channel the record credits — production, imports, the magic offset — and its tail is the record's own residual, with the sentence naming the magic channel when it is non-zero, screen and PDF alike; (2) a CENSUS of every bar, gauge, ring, share bar and stacked meter on the dossier (screen tabs, the Overview, the dossier engine sections) and in the PDF, listing for each the field its widths are drawn from and the field its printed figure is read from; every pair that differs is cured to one field, and a walker pins the census so no chart can drift again. - **§934.30 ADDENDUM — THE LANDING NARRATIVE APPROVED ("do your recommendations", 2026-09-19 ~14:1x EDT; lane 33 writes it).** The owner approved lane 33's draft (one account in the arrow's order, every bound claim verbatim, every fact traced to the regenerated fixture) with the chair's two recommendations: the three middle section asks become plain read-on links (one ask at the top, one at the end), and the unused why-trace tag is deleted with the season in its slot. The copy's quoted facts are pinned against the fixture so a regeneration reds prose that went stale. Vetoable.
- **§934.35 A DEVELOPMENT-ONLY PREVIEW PERSONA IN PLACE OF A DUMMY ADMIN ACCOUNT (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~14:4x EDT: "give me a dummy admin account for our preview purposes only"; lane 30 builds).** The chair may not create accounts or handle passwords, so the preview gets a persona instead: a `VITE_PREVIEW_ROLE` switch honoured only by the development server, supplying the client-side role (the admin view — the Developer menu item, /admin, the tier gates open) while the session stays what it is and nothing reaches the server as a claim; compiled out of every production build and pinned absent from the built bundle; a visible "PREVIEW PERSONA" marker in the account menu while active. Limit stated: server-gated features (the AI layer among them) still need a real staff account and migration 201. The owner's real admin grant remains the one SQL statement in the Supabase dashboard. Vetoable.
- **§934.36 DESIGN PROPOSAL, NOT YET ORDERED — EDIT MODE, POOLS, THE DECREE REGISTRY AND THE GUARDS (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~17:3x EDT: "let's just think it through before we implement anything").** The owner's model: on a saved settlement in the library, Edit puts the dossier into a mode where every editable card carries a pencil; clicking a card opens a modal over a darkened page holding every field the card owns (empty fields shown empty); every value comes from a typed pool (drop-down, search, or both), nothing typed free; quick-save at the foot; every save enters a registry at the bottom of the dossier in order; leaving edit mode and advancing time applies the entries in that order; guards warn "X must happen before Y" with three options — fulfil X automatically, do it yourself, or cancel. THE CHAIR'S REFINEMENTS: (1) cards declare their editable fields once in the domain and the modal is generated from the declaration; (2) names are pooled through the culture's name generator with "roll another" and the world's own names, and a DM's own words enter only through the compendium; prose is never a field — it follows the facts; (3) the registry is the Change Dock moved into the document (a page of pending decrees in the tome): reorderable, entries removable before application, each stating what it does and requires; (4) THE ONE MODEL CHANGE: a field's declaration decides its kind — a CORRECTION (a record fact: applies on save, never a chronicle event) or an EVENT (queued, applied in order at the tick as a first-class cause the pulse propagates, written into the chronicle with the table's hand as its cause) — the modal says "takes effect now / when time advances"; (5) guards are authored prerequisites on operation types, a pure engine over queue + world, honest about coverage (no rule, no guard); "fulfil it for me" inserts a visible seeded entry marked as added; a CONTRADICTION guard (reorder, drop one, or keep both and let the chronicle record it); duration ("this takes time") hands the entry to the pulse as a project; (6) two unifications earned: the Surveyor's proposals land in the same registry, and the advance report speaks the regeneration card's vocabulary (direct, propagated, kept). Strains named: apply-at-advance without the correction split frustrates; pools cage until the compendium is the valve; the dependency graph must start small and true; the pulse must treat decrees as causes. NEW CAPABILITY, a program of several lanes across domain, store, guards, pulse, dialogs and the Surveyor; sequenced after the push and the public-path review; the guards first, because the game is the world pushing back. Awaiting the owner's word.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — THE PLUS (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~18:1x EDT): "next to every appropriate section, when edit is on, should be a plus sign so that they can add things like institutions or new NPCs or new factions and powers."** The chair's refinements: the plus is the pencil for a thing that does not exist yet — the same modal, empty, the type fixed by the section, "Add" where "Save" sits, the entry a decree in the same registry; an addition defaults to an EVENT (founded, arrived, raised — applied at the tick, the pulse deriving its consequences) with "it was always here" as the correction form that backfills the DM's layer over the untouched seed; the pools already exist (the institution catalogue, the culture's name generator with roles from the world's own institutions, the typed faction archetypes, the power structure) and so do most guards (the structural validator's tier rules; faction power summing to a hundred — "how much, from whom", or an engine rebalance shown as an inserted entry); the DM adds the fact, the engine derives the rest; add the MINUS as an event with a cause from a pool (died, left, burned, dissolved, seized) so the chronicle records it; DM-minted identities in their own namespace; section counts answer to the validator's tier ranges. Still a proposal awaiting the owner's word; sequenced after the push and the public-path review.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — GUARDS ARE SUGGESTIVE (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~18:2x EDT): "these are all suggestive because in the magical world something can just happen overnight or the DM playing God decides so."** A guard informs and offers the coherent path; it never refuses. The options are fulfil it for me, let me do it, and proceed as it is (cancel remains the DM's own choice, never the guard's verdict); durations are suggestive too. An entry applied over a warning is chronicled with the table's hand as its cause and nothing invented to explain it — the pulse may write "overnight, by means the town does not understand", never a fabricated cause. Recorded into the proposal.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — THE FLAVOR TIER MAY BE TYPED (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~18:3x EDT): "There are some things that can be typed. Names for example can be typed. So it should be our objective to figure out what those things are that do not tighten into any other kind of derivation or sequence or consequence. It may just be pure flavor."** The chair's rule: a field may be typed when nothing downstream reads its value as a fact — no derivation, no guard, no pulse consequence, no register — its only readers print it; the set is a CENSUS with a proof per field from the writer-reach and observed-shape instruments (readers only in display and print), not a list by taste; expected members: names (NPCs, institutions, factions, the settlement — identity comes from the seed, never the name), epithets, mottoes, devices, signs, the DM's own note fields; boundaries: typed text may be quoted by narration but never parsed into facts (a DM's words gain consequences only through the compendium, where they take a type); the editable-field declaration marks each field pool or free and a walker refuses a free field that gains a derivation reader; plain text with length limits (the PDF's fonts must set it); "roll another" beside every name. Recorded into the proposal.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — ON-STAGE AND OFF-STAGE COUNTERPARTIES (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~18:4x EDT: must a standing military, a trade relationship or a dynamic require a realm with connected settlements, versus a DM sending a force out for an imaginary war or trading with a nonexistent settlement for theatrical purposes?).** The chair: do not require the realm, but be exact about what it buys — two-sided truth (both settlements simulated, the world deciding outcomes). Off-stage counterparties are PHANTOMS: named by the DM, minted by the engine from a seed with enough typed facts (kind, size, stance, pooled traits, "roll another") for the home derivations that read a partner record to run; consequences at home are real events the pulse carries (fewer defenders, the upkeep purse, morale, hands off the harvest, casualties and returns; a commodity flow on the home ledger); outcomes abroad are the DM's decrees or a pooled roll (victory, defeat, stalemate, a truce bought) applied at a tick, never simulated on the phantom's side; the chronicle records off-stage events as such ("against a host from beyond the map"); promotion keeps continuity — a phantom later forged and placed in the realm takes the phantom's seed, so its traits and its written history carry over. Recorded into the proposal.
- **§934.37 THE EDIT-MODE ARCHITECTURE IS WRITTEN (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~18:5x EDT: "comprehensively refine and architect all of this out … for implementation"; the chair).** `docs/DESIGN_EDIT_MODE_AND_DECREES.md` — thesis, vocabulary, the model (field declarations, pools, the single op path, the DM's layer, the persisted registry, corrections now and events at the tick, suggestive guards with three offers and recorded overrides, phantoms with promotion by seed), the surfaces (edit mode, the generated modal, the registry page in the tome's idiom, the advance report, the Surveyor unified, the PDF), the data flow, persistence through the observed-shape door, seven instruments, a seven-lane program (guards before surfaces), four open decisions for the owner, and the risks. Implementation waits on the owner's word and on the push and the public-path review.

But we're building this first.").** The edit-mode program (§934.36–37) is built FIRST, after the 2026-09-18 consist's push; the simulator's build-out (the paused architecture program of §934.16) follows it; the public-path review (§934.24) runs as a read-only walk beside them. - **§934.36 ADDENDUM — THE GATE AND THE CANON RULE (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~20:0x EDT).** "Editors, door and corrections are behind Cartographer gate as well" — the whole editor is Cartographer's (open decision 1 closed). And: "edit mode has two different settings behind one tag. If a town is canonized then every edit becomes an event. If it is not canonized, then they are just simply edits." — the settlement's state decides the effect: a draft takes plain edits that apply now; a canonized settlement turns every edit into an event at the next advance. The chair's per-field correction/event declaration is withdrawn in favour of this rule (design §2.6 amended). Noted for the owner: on a canonized town even a name's typo becomes an event; a record-correction affordance for canon would be a small addition, not a model change.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — REVERSIBLE UNTIL TIME ADVANCES, AND THE CARD REAPPEARS (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~20:2x EDT).** "anything can be reversible from edit up until advance time happens. And even then, if someone reverts back time because we have that option, those edits go back into waiting sequence. A user should be able to click that list of sequence, events, and waiting and be able to make those edits if they need. The card reappears. And it gets placed back exactly in the sequence where necessary." Design §2.5a: every entry reopens its own card at any status and returns to its exact order index; a reverted tick returns its applied decrees to the waiting sequence in order with their chronicle lines retracted; application changes status, never deletes.
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — SEQUENCE AND CONNECTION (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~20:3x EDT: "where the sequence is appropriate it should connect those ideas where they are out of sequence. Should we treat them as completely unrelated?").** No: the relation is declared knowledge in the op catalogue; in sequence Y cites X as its ground automatically; out of sequence the guard offers to connect (reorder, fulfil in place, or proceed independent with nothing invented between); the DM may set an explicit follows-from link between any two entries and the chronicle writes them as one account. Never blocking (design §2.7a).
- **§934.36 ADDENDUM — THE EDGES INTEGRATED, AND EDITS DO NOT TRAVEL (the owner, 2026-09-19 ~21:2x EDT: "integrate them according to your best judgment. I would say that edits do not show when they are forked or imported or put into gallery.").** Design §11: the DM's layer and the registry live only in the owner's save — forks, imports and the gallery carry the seed's world alone (consequence stated: a backup export cannot restore edits unless the owner later allows the export to carry them while imports still strip); a governed migration folds today's Change Dock and inline edits into the registry and the layer; an optional `when` schedules an entry; a contention guard for two entries on one fact; authored pools for the chronicle's voice; seeded rolls; spatial edits out of scope; free-text hygiene with a font-coverage check; the player projection through the existing secrecy classes; the Surveyor's credit charged at compile only; bulk realm ops as a later extension; edit counts by op type from the first lane. Vetoable.
